# AWS Containers

Container skills for the main agent: EKS, ECS, Fargate, ECR, and App Runner design and troubleshooting, with the EKS and ECS MCP servers (read-only) and Finch for building and pushing images.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the [`aws-platform-engineer`](../../agent-plugins/aws-platform-engineer) agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-containers@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-containers:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `aws-containers` | Builds and deploys containerized workloads on Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Elastic Container Service (ECS), Fargate, and ECR (Elastic Container Registry). |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-containers:build-push-image` | Build a container image with Finch and push it to Amazon ECR |
| `/aws-containers:ecs-troubleshoot` | Diagnose failing ECS services, tasks, or deployments |
| `/aws-containers:eks-troubleshoot` | Diagnose an unhealthy EKS cluster, node group, or workload |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-containers_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |
| `eks` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.eks-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-containers_eks__*` | Read-only by default. Add --allow-write / --allow-sensitive-data-access to enable mutations and pod logs/secrets. |
| `ecs` | stdio | `uvx awslabs-ecs-mcp-server@latest` `--with` | `mcp__plugin_aws-containers_ecs__*` | Read-only by default. Set ALLOW_WRITE / ALLOW_SENSITIVE_DATA to true to enable mutations. fastmcp<4 works around an upstream incompatibility (add_tool_transformation was removed in fastmcp 4). |
| `finch` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.finch-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-containers_finch__*` | Builds and pushes container images with the local Finch CLI. ECR repository creation is off by default (add --enable-aws-resource-write). |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
